BasePK: 3071214
Chunk index: 0

Speech chunk:
I question the veracity and the integrity of a group which would delay the passage of this bill and which says it is the upholder of John Q. Public and the downtrodden masses, and yet its members are not prepared to address themselves to the problems dealt with in this bill dealing with the blind, the chronically ill, or to the problems regarding farms transferred from fathers to sons. None of these issues which are important to John Q. Public has been mentioned by the members of the NDP. They are stuck on clause 21, and they do not give a damn about invalids in wheelchairs for the rest of their lives, or about people who are chronically blind. If they did, they would find those parts of the bill and deal with them. I think their conduct is reprehensible.

Chunk index: 0

Speech chunk:
Mr. Speaker, my question is for the Minister of Manpower and Immigration. Is the minister in a position to tell the House whether a decision has been made with regard to extending the deadline for the Canada Works Program and the Young Canada Works Program in areas of high unemployment where the rate of application has been unusually slow due to the fact that application forms were in the constituencies for less than three weeks? In my opinion, there has not been sufficient public relations.
